description: This short unmaintained trail takes you downhill to a very large Douglas Fir tree. There are a number of large trees in this area. The walk is less than 10 minutes to the "Elaho Giant"

stats.Closure: Trail is CLOSED due to hazards from dead and burned trees, as a result of the Elaho Fire in 2015. The Elaho Giant Tree has unfortunately been confirmed dead as well.

title: Elaho Giant Trail
